### **Job Description**


**Job Description: Senior BI QA Lead**

 **Location: Chennai/Pune/Hyderabad**

 **Work Type: Hybrid** **Experience : 10\+Years**  

The Senior Business Intelligence QA Tester is responsible for ensuring the quality, accuracy, and reliability of enterprise reporting, analytics, and data integration solutions. This role focuses on **testing Tableau dashboards, SSRS reports, and SSIS data integration** processes to ensure business requirements are met and data quality is maintained throughout the reporting lifecycle. The position works closely with Business Analysts, Data Engineers, BI Developers, and business stakeholders to identify defects, validate data integrity, and support the successful delivery of business intelligence solutions. The Senior BI QA Tester also drives testing standards, promotes best practices, and contributes to continuous improvements in data quality and reporting reliability.

 **Technical Skills**

  

* Extensive experience **testing Tableau dashboards** and analytics solutions.
* Strong experience validating **SSRS reports** and report subscriptions.
* Experience testing **SSIS packages**, **ETL workflows**, and data movement processes.
* Advanced **SQL** skills for data validation, reconciliation, and root cause analysis.
* Experience working with data warehouses, relational databases, and dimensional data models.
* Strong understanding of data integration, **ETL, ELT**, and reporting architectures.
* Experience using **Azure DevOps** for test management, defect tracking, and Agile delivery support.
* Experience with **API validation** and interface testing is desirable.
* Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server, Azure Data Services, and cloud\-based BI platforms.

 **Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills**

  

* Ability to analyse complex business requirements and translate them into detailed test scenarios.
* Strong investigative and troubleshooting skills for identifying data quality and reporting issues.
* Ability to perform detailed root cause analysis across data pipelines and reporting solutions.
* Strong attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and consistency.

 **Ownership \& Collaboration**

  

* Experience working closely with Business Analysts, BI Developers, Data Engineers, Product Owners, and business stakeholders.
* Ability to independently manage testing activities across multiple BI projects.
* Proven ability to influence quality practices and improve testing processes.

 **Quality \& Process Expertise**

  

* Experience developing BI testing strategies, standards, and best practices.
* Ability to define and measure quality metrics including defect leakage, test coverage, data quality indicators, and release readiness.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies, and testing lifecycle management.

 **Soft Skills**

  

* High attention to detail and a proactive mindset.
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Ability to work independently and manage priorities in fast\-paced environments.
* Effective communication of complex issues in clear, concise language.

 **Experience Requirements**

  

* Typically, 10\+ years of QA experience, with at least 2\+ years in a senior or lead role.
* Demonstrated experience working in cross\-functional squads or Agile teams.
* Proven track record of delivering high\-quality releases in complex systems.

 **Preferred Certifications**

  

* STQB Foundation or Advanced Certification.
* Microsoft Data Platform or Azure Data certifications.
* Tableau Desktop Specialist or Tableau Certified Professional.
* Certified Software Quality Analyst (CSQA).

 **Specific Work Preferences**

  

* Experience testing enterprise\-scale reporting and analytics platforms.
* Strong understanding of healthcare, manufacturing, or regulated business environments.
* Experience validating large and complex datasets.
* Understanding of BI performance testing and report optimisation techniques.
* Familiarity with data governance, data lineage, and master data concepts.

 **Specific Skills and/or Business Competencies**

  

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong SQL development and query\-writing capabilities.
* Advanced analytical and investigative mindset.
* High attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Experience working within Agile delivery teams.
* Ability to prioritise testing efforts based on business risk and impact.
* Strong understanding of business intelligence reporting, ETL processing, and data validation methodologies.
* Ability to challenge requirements and identify potential reporting or data quality risks proactively.

 **Leadership Competencies**

  

* Strategic thinker with the ability to translate quality goals into executable team programs.
* Strong people leader with a proven ability to develop, coach, and retain high\-performing QA teams.
* Effective communicator and collaborator across engineering, product, and executive stakeholders.
* Data\-driven decision maker with a strong focus on measurable quality outcomes.
* Proactive risk identifier with a relentless commitment to delivery excellence and client satisfaction.

title: IST Switch Tester (Chennai/Bangalore)
description:
**Position Type :**

Full time**Type Of Hire :**

Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)**IST Switch Tester for Bangalore \& Chennai**


At FIS, our technology and our people are moving forward. We advance the way the world pays, banks and invests. We believe in building inclusive, diverse teams. Together, we innovate to help our colleagues, clients and communities succeed. If you’re ready to grow your career and make an impact in fintech, we have one question: Are you FIS?  

  

**About the role:**  

As a QA Test Lead, you’ll test and perfect the fintech products that will change the way people around the world pay, bank and invest. This critical role involves establishing compliance processes with your team and implementing a quality maturity roadmap for each IT functional area.  

  

**What you will be doing:**

* Reporting into the Quality Assurance Director you will be leading the team of QA Test Analysts in a large program of work
* Preparing Test deliverables such as Test Plans, Test Execution Status Reports/Metrics, Team Status Reports, Test Summary/Completion Reports
* Schedule weekly meeting with the client, capture the pain points, take minutes, address the pain points and track them to closure
* Using your Payments Testing knowledge, be onsite at Client site when required, working alongside and guiding them through the System Integration, User Acceptance, Schemes Cert Test Phases etc.
* Reviewing functional and design specifications to ensure full understanding of individual deliverables
* Work closely with the project team to guarantee quality of delivery and ensure all outputs are aligned with key project success metrics
* Effectively communicates testing activities and findings in oral and written forms
* Able to co\-ordinate and work with onshore and offshore teams
* Assist in the release process and with improving and automating the process
* Hold and facilitate test plan/case reviews with cross\-functional team members
* Identify any potential quality issues per defined process and escalate potential quality issues immediately to management
* Ensure that validated deliverables meet functional and design specifications and requirements and creating a Requirements Traceability Matrix as required
* Track and monitor defects in JIRA, schedule defects triage with development team and Clients as required
* Comply with all FIS policies and procedures
* Other related duties assigned as needed.

 **What you will need:**

* Min. 8\+ years’ experience in a Software testing role and must have experience in any of the FIS products ( Connex, IST CLR\&MAS, DN)
* A background with financial services industry practices, regulations and processes
* Transaction switching or Payments Testing experience (eftpos, card schemes MCard/Visa etc.)
* Experience in testing using stubs and simulators
* Experience in Schemes Certification testing
* Experience in leading test teams through System Integration Testing test phases
* Leadership experience to mentor and guide QA Analysts
* Proficiency in quality management methods, tools and technologies.
* A bachelor’s in computer science, information systems, business administration or other related discipline, or the equivalent experience
* Ability to demonstrate interpersonal and teambuilding skills working with technical and non\-technical individuals
* Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing
* Team skills, including the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships both internally and externally
* Organizational and time management skills
* To be a self\-starter with proven ability to work independently

 **Added bonus if you have:**

* Experience in the following Applications: **IST/Merchant Account \& Settlement (MAS), IST/Clearing (CLR), Data Navigator, Connex \&/or Webpay/Digipay**
* Experience in the following Tools/Sims: Test Rail, Jira, FINsim
* ISTQB Foundation Software Testing certification
* Knowledge of network message standards \- AS2805 or ISO standards

  

**What we offer you:*** An exciting opportunity be a part of Worlds Leading FinTech Product MNC
* To be a part of vibrant team and to build up a career on core banking/payments domain
* A broad range of professional education and personal development possibilities FIS is your final career step!
* Time to support charities and give back in your community

**Privacy Statement**


FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

**Sourcing Model**


Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.
